# SEO Technical Audit — Detailed Findings

**Date:** 2026-11-15. Companion to `SEO_AUDIT_REPORT.md` (the narrative summary) — this file has the full evidence lists. Generated by building the site fresh (`pnpm build` → 235 pages) and running `node scripts/seo-crawl.mjs` plus targeted source-code checks against that build. No finding below is inferred or assumed; each one names the exact command or file that produced it.

**Root cause:** the `description` field in each blog post's frontmatter was written for completeness/readability rather than against a hard character budget — most read as a full, well-formed two-sentence summary rather than a clipped search snippet. The homepage, 7 of 7 industry pages, and `/pricing/` are also over the limit, so this isn't purely a "blog content velocity" problem — it includes hand-tuned marketing pages too.

**Evidence/method:** `node scripts/seo-crawl.mjs` warning output, cross-checked against `d['warnings']` in the JSON report (`--json` flag), filtered for `length > 160`.

## 3. P2 — Images missing an explicit `loading` attribute: still open

**Method:** direct regex scan of every `<img>` tag across all 235 built pages (`dist/**/index.html`), same methodology as the Oct 28 audit's T04.

**Result:** 1,032 of 1,052 `<img>` tags (98%) have no explicit `loading` attribute. 20 have `loading="lazy"`. **Zero** have `loading="eager"` — meaning even the single largest above-the-fold/LCP image per page (hero images) has no explicit priority hint.

This is the same issue the Oct 28 audit flagged as T04 (then: 682/702, 97%). A prior task record in this project's history describes "low-risk loading fixes" as completed between then and now, but the measured current code does not reflect a site-wide fix — whatever that change touched, it did not reach the bulk of `<img>` usage. Stated as measured fact, not a criticism of that prior work's intent.

**Likely fix location:** Astro's built-in `<Image>`/`<Picture>` components (if in use) accept a `loading` prop directly; for hand-written `<img>` tags in components like blog post cards, industry cards, and hero sections, this needs to be added explicitly per component, with `loading="eager" fetchpriority="high"` reserved for the single hero image on each page template and `loading="lazy"` everywhere else.

## 4. P1 — No analytics installed anywhere on the site: still open

**Method:** `grep -r` for `gtag`, `googletagmanager`, `google-analytics`, and a GA4 measurement-ID pattern (`G-[A-Z0-9]{6,}`) across `src/` and `apps/gateway/src/`. Zero matches in either tree.

Same as Oct 28's T10. Compounds the Search Console/GA4 access gap: even once credentials are granted to *a* property, no tracking snippet exists on the live site yet to populate it.

## 5. P2 — Inconsistent `robots` handling across equivalent `/learn/*` auth pages

**Method:** read every route file under `apps/gateway/src/app/learn/{login,register,forgot-password,reset-password,verify-email,dashboard,admin}` for a `robots` metadata export.

| Route | Has own `layout.tsx`? | `robots` override | robots.txt `Disallow`? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/learn/reset-password/` | Yes | `{ index: false, follow: false }` | Yes |
| `/learn/verify-email/` | Yes | `{ index: false, follow: false }` | Yes |
| `/learn/dashboard/*` | Yes | `{ index: false, follow: false }` | Yes |
| `/learn/admin/*` | Yes | `{ index: false, follow: false }` | Yes |
| **`/learn/login/`** | **No** (`page.tsx` only) | **None — inherits parent's indexable default** | **No** |
| **`/learn/register/`** | **No** (`page.tsx` only) | **None — inherits parent's indexable default** | **No** |
| **`/learn/forgot-password/`** | **No** (`page.tsx` only) | **None — inherits parent's indexable default** | **No** |

Three of seven functionally-equivalent utility/auth pages are indexable while the other four (correctly) aren't. No unique, search-worthy content exists on a login/register/forgot-password page — indexing them is a thin-content/crawl-budget inconsistency, not a security issue (robots.txt/noindex is not an access control mechanism regardless).

## 6. Confirmed clean (re-verified, not assumed carried over from Oct 28)

All from a fresh `node scripts/seo-crawl.mjs` run against the current 235-page build — **0 hard failures**:

- 0 duplicate `<title>` tags
- 0 duplicate meta descriptions
- 0 missing meta descriptions
- 0 missing or mismatched canonical URLs
- 0 pages with 0 or >1 `<h1>`
- 0 images missing `alt` text
- 0 broken internal links (within the Astro-crawlable surface)
- 0 noindexed pages leaking into `sitemap-0.xml`
- Orphan pages: exactly 2 (`/book/thanks/`, `/contact/thanks/`) — both deliberately unlinked post-submission pages, correct and expected, not a defect

**Structured data**, verified by parsing every page's JSON-LD (not just checking for the script tag's presence): `ProfessionalService` + `WebSite` on all 235 pages, `BreadcrumbList` on 232 (correctly absent only on `/`, `/book/thanks/`, `/contact/thanks/`), `FAQPage` on 105, `BlogPosting` on 86, `Service` on 10, one each `ContactPage`/`ProfilePage`+`Person`/`Article`. **Zero** instances of `LocalBusiness`, `Review`, `Rating`, or `AggregateRating` anywhere in the codebase — the project's anti-fabrication rule is enforced in the actual templates, not just stated in docs.

**Robots/noindex defense-in-depth on administrative routes**, verified by reading source directly: `/admin/layout.tsx` sets `robots: { index: false, follow: false }` for the entire admin app, on top of `robots.txt`'s `Disallow: /admin/`. `/learn/dashboard`, `/learn/admin` (the internal blocked duplicate panel), `/learn/reset-password`, and `/learn/verify-email` all carry the same page-level noindex plus a matching `robots.txt Disallow` line. This is correct, deliberate, two-layer protection — not an accident of robots.txt alone (which Google explicitly does not treat as a true indexing control).

**Sitemap hygiene**: `astro.config.mjs`'s sitemap `filter()` now explicitly excludes `/contact/thanks`, `/book/thanks`, and `/blog/tag/` paths, and `robots.txt` correctly references both `https://shahidiqbal.com/sitemap-index.xml` and the separately-generated `https://shahidiqbal.com/learn/sitemap.xml`. The `/blog/tag/` exclusion is new since Oct 28 — that was flagged then as T05 ("sitemap includes all 73 noindex tag pages") and is now fixed, confirmed by reading the current config, not assumed.

## 7. Internationalization — unchanged baseline

`<html lang="en">` site-wide, zero `hreflang` tags, no Arabic or other-language routes. Confirmed via the same grep methodology as Oct 28, against the current build.

## 8. Out of scope for this pass, flagged as a gap

A full page-by-page SEO audit of `apps/gateway`'s own public-facing pages (`/learn/courses/*` listing and detail pages, `/learn/personal-training/`) — their own `generateMetadata` quality, internal linking, and structured data — was not performed in this pass. The Astro-side crawl script cannot see into a separately-rendered Next.js app. This should be a named sub-task in Phase 6 or 7, not assumed clean because the Astro site next to it is clean.
